def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    threes=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==3]
    i0=min(a for a,b in threes); i1=max(a for a,b in threes)
    j0=min(b for a,b in threes); j1=max(b for a,b in threes)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for i in range(i0,i1+1):
        for j in range(j0,j1+1):
            if g[i][j]==3: continue
            dist=min(abs(i-a)+abs(j-b) for a,b in threes)
            if dist>0:
                out[i][j]= 4 if dist%2==1 else 2
    return out
